gates.name: final-browser-sequence
gates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,os,subprocess
packet=Path('_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/tests/five-ordinary-topology-admin-actions-and-state-checks-2026-11-10').resolve()
environment=os.environ.copy(); environment['CI']='true'
steps=[('browser-ui-and-formatters-after-readiness',['npm','run','test:ui','--','specs/shared-portal-display-formatters.spec.ts','--retries=0']),('held-negotiation-repeat',['npm','run','test','--','specs/admin-parties-list.spec.ts','--project=chromium','--grep','negotiation is held','--repeat-each=5','--retries=0'])]
results=[]
for name,command in steps:
 log=packet/('final-'+name+'.log')
 with log.open('w') as stream: result=subprocess.run(command,cwd='tests/e2e',env=environment,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 results.append({'name':name,'command':command,'cwd':'tests/e2e','environment':{'CI':'true'},'exit_code':result.returncode,'log':log.name})
 (packet/'final-browser-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
 if result.returncode: raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
PY
